scope: Two exact-harness route-free official MCP SDK 2.3.1 installed-package replays of 698 controlled failed-DNS calls that fill the 1000-call process-hour budget, with sampled server FDs during that phase and post-fill server/container high-water counters. Each run installed the checksum-verified unsigned experimental Debian 12 amd64 package in a fresh disposable 128 MiB / 64 PID container with a 64-FD server soft limit.
tested_package_manifest: SHA256SUMS from exact-main CI run 42199265023; all three files verified before testing
reproduce: Install pinned SDK with npm ci --prefix tools/mcp-sdk-probe --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; set OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_DIR to that directory, OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_PACKAGE to the verified .deb, OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_PACKAGE_SHA256 to its 64-character digest, then run bash tools/netns_adversarial_probe.sh target/debug/outbound-guard-mcp twice.
checks: The SDK fixture made 698 additional failed-DNS calls after 302 prior reserved calls, then a 1001st call to a fresh allowed host was denied before DNS/HTTP; bounded redacted audit and tools/list passed. Both installed runs passed 3370 decisions. During the hour fill, a requested 5 ms server-FD sampler recorded maxima of 4 with 100/118 samples; final server FD count was 3, server VmHWM 5232/5228 KiB, container memory peak 21762048/19742720 bytes and PID peak 14, with zero OOM events under 64 FD / 64 PID / 128 MiB limits. Package hash/version/install, removal/residue and container/namespace cleanup passed.
harness_correction: An initial disposable run failed a probe-only assertion requiring more than 3 FDs after the calls had completed; the installed server correctly returned to its three stdio FDs. The assertion was corrected to allow 3 current FDs while retaining a sampled-peak check, then two complete package-installed runs passed. No server code changed.
local_verification: Two installed-package route-free suites each passed 3370 decisions; 47 Rust tests, 19 Python tests, cargo build --locked --bins --examples, cargo fmt/clippy, JS/Python syntax, JSON parse and diff checks passed.
sampling: The 5 ms interval is requested, not a hard real-time schedule; a shorter transient FD peak can be missed. Server VmHWM is process-specific; container memory/PID high-water include Docker exec helpers and all earlier fixture phases, so the high-water cannot be attributed solely to the hour fill. Measurements end before uninstall and do not establish sustained behavior.
limitations: One modern SDK client, one experimental Debian package/OS/architecture and two finite sequential runs. This is evidence under stated limits, not a general memory or FD bound, arbitrary concurrency or sustained load. It does not cover other native clients, traffic through other tools, exact official candidate, owner residual-risk acceptance or independent human review. Four AI Scraping Defense repositories still require separate adversarial evidence.
